Update27 October 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Launcher Update 2.2.0
New Launcher version: Required for the new client beta!

Hello everyone,

Launcher version 2.2.0 is now out! We are letting players download it manually for the next few hours as we've switched rendering frontends and want to ensure it's stable. Once confirmed we'll publish it officially.

Patch Notes

  • Changed rendering frontend to remove requirement on WebView2
  • Added support for New Client Beta
  • Various bugfixes

Linux only

  • Added better auto-update support

Download Links & Install Steps

  • WINDOWS: https://aa-classic.com/api/download/launcher2.2.0.exe
  • LINUX: https://aa-classic.com/api/download/linux/launcher2.2.0.AppImage

Install steps: Download the file for your OS and place it in your game installation directory. That's it!
